expectations.text: Cites Decree No. 330/2026/ND-CP, issued and effective August 19, 2026, as the operative sanctions regime (82 articles, 33 on personal data protection)
expectations.evidence: "Decree No. 330/2026/ND-CP, which was issued and took effect on 19 August 2026 (82 articles, 33 of which deal specifically with personal data protection)"

expectations.text: States the serious cross-border penalty structure correctly: percentage-of-revenue fines on prior-year VIETNAM-market revenue in bands — 1–2% (10k–<100k data subjects), 2–3% (100k–<1M), 3–5% (≥1M subjects or national defence/security impact)
expectations.evidence: "a percentage of the organisation's prior-year Vietnam-market revenue... 1–2% for incidents affecting 10,000 to under 100,000 data subjects, 2–3% for 100,000 to under 1 million, and 3–5% for one million or more data subjects, or where there is national defence/security impact"

expectations.text: States the fixed-fine fallback: VND tiers up to 3 billion where there is no Vietnam revenue or the percentage falls below the fixed tier
expectations.evidence: "Where the organisation has no Vietnam revenue, or the percentage calculation falls below a fixed floor, the decree substitutes fixed VND amounts: 200–500 million, 500 million–1 billion, and 1–3 billion"

expectations.text: Covers unlawful data trading: 2×–10× unlawful proceeds, with fixed fines up to VND 3 billion where proceeds are indeterminable
expectations.evidence: "Unlawful data trading (Article 53) is penalized at 2–10 times the unlawful proceeds. Where proceeds cannot be determined, fixed fines of VND 500 million–1 billion... rising to VND 1–3 billion"

expectations.text: Notes organisational fines are double individual fines, and remedial measures beyond fines: suspension of processing/transfers, compulsory data destruction, disgorgement, confiscation
expectations.evidence: "individual violators are penalized at half the organisational rate" (equivalent to org fines double); remedial: "suspension of processing activities or cross-border transfers, compulsory destruction... disgorgement of unlawful proceeds, and confiscation of instrumentalities"
